title: Halmin nasir yansurna
body:
halmin nasir yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
roro ke kaha ye sarwar ne
koi nahi mera apna
kaha hussain ne kaha hussain ne
ran me khada hoo'n mai tanha
gird hai mere ahle jafa
qatl huwa lashkar mera
<<MINI>>
halmin nasir yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dulaare aun o mohd
khuld sidhaare aun o mohd
shukr ka sajda khwahar ka
<<MINI>>
halmin nasir yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki nishani bachna saki
tasveer e hasan pamaal huwi
tukdo'n me bati wo laashe haseen
<<MINI>>
halmin nasir yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
dariya pe gaya ghazi jo mera
paani na piya pyaasa hi raha
baazu bhi kate mashkiza chhida
<<MINI>>
halmin nasir yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
atthara baras ka laal mera
barchhi se kaleja jiska chhida
lasha mai utha laya uska
<<MINI>>
halmin nasir yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hashr huwa maqtal me bapa
jab shimr ne kata sheh ka gala
ab tak bhi fazao'n me hai sada
<<MINI>>
halmin nasir yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
ye anjuman e saqqae haram
ta hashr rahegi ye qayam
mahir hai ye nouha dard bhara
<<MINI>>
halmin nasir yansurna
